description: Transformer attention visualizer: tokenize -> embeddings -> positional -> self-attention heatmap -> multi-head -> feed-forward/residual/norm -> output probabilities; step controls, architecture diagram + live stage side-by-side.

criteria: network-transformer.html is one self-contained interactive explainer of a Transformer (no libraries): for a typed sentence it visualizes tokenization, embeddings, positional encoding, self-attention with a live attention matrix/heatmap, multi-head attention, feed-forward, residual connections and normalization, and output token probabilities; with play/pause/step controls, a persistent architecture diagram shown next to the live stage, and beginner-friendly explanations.
